p.i: opere demonstremus. Sic in iis, ad quæ omnes perve-nimus, eadem ambulantes regulâ, idem sentiremus, & spe magnâ armati confidere possemus, Deum reliquas veritates nostrâ operâ interveniente etiam aliis revela-turum. Id quod saxit Deus benignissimus, gratiâ & ef-ficaciâ Spiritus Sancti nos ducens in omnem veritatem. Amen.

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Transcribed as printed: the long s is given as s, and the word "saxit" should read "fuxit" or similar, but the text is kept as legible. The digitiser's "Digitized by Google" mark and scan specks are omitted.
